title: macaranga moluccana
intro: Macaranga moluccana, commonly known as 'Mangosteen Tree', is a species of tree in the family Euphorbiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it effective in treating various ailments such as fever, diarrhea, and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Macaranga moluccana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including xanthones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-cancer, anti-diabetic, and anti-inflammatory activities. However, further research is needed to confirm the effectiveness and safety of using Macaranga moluccana for medicinal purposes.
